source.limitations: Transcribed as printed from Tuscarawas County Health Department PDF 2026_septage_hauler_1_21_2026.pdf linked from Water Quality Program (Well and Septic). 10 named haulers. Spellings kept as printed including Carrolton, Kline's Environment Service, Shetler Services Inc, and Speedie mailing P.O. Box 167. No operators or registration numbers printed; ODH bond unknown. Separate 2026 Septic Service Providers PDF on the same parent page was not used. Hauler registration is not an inspection credential. Not an endorsement.
